source.title: Three open questions on residually small rings

trace.notes: Input normalized as one URL. Direct fetch of https://zbmath.org/7201561 returned a Cloudflare challenge/403, so the zbMATH Open API was used only as resolver metadata for the same identifier.

zbMATH API identifier 7201561 resolved to the journal article titled Three open questions on residually small rings with DOI 10.1216/rmj.2020.50.177 and Project Euclid locator rmjm/1588233637. These metadata were not used as technical extraction evidence.

DOI resolution and Crossref both led to the Project Euclid full-article URL, but Project Euclid returned an Incapsula/JavaScript challenge rather than readable HTML or PDF. Direct Euclid PDF endpoint guesses also returned challenge HTML.

OpenAlex confirmed the exact DOI and title but reported open_access.is_oa=false, oa_status=closed, best_oa_location=null, and any_repository_has_fulltext=false. Exact-title search candidates inspected were metadata/profile/listing pages or a different referenced work, not readable full text for the same article.

No readable primary full-text artifact was recovered. The available zbMATH review, Crossref record, OpenAlex record, and search snippets are resolver metadata or secondary descriptions, so the source adequacy gate prevents extracting questions from them.
Saved exact JSON payload to outputs/parse-paper/7201561.json and outputs/latest.json.
